title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Sobre a Vaga:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Senior Data Scientist altamente qualificado(a) e versátil para integrar nossa equipe de analytics avançado. Nesta função, você será responsável por projetar, desenvolver e implementar sistemas de recomendação, modelos de previsão de séries temporais e soluções de machine learning baseadas em algoritmos de boosting e árvores de decisão. Você trabalhará em estreita colaboração com equipes multifuncionais para transformar dados em insights acionáveis e soluções escaláveis.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e otimizar sistemas de recomendação (filtragem colaborativa, baseada em conteúdo, abordagens híbridas).
  • Construir e validar modelos de previsão de séries temporais utilizando técnicas tradicionais e de machine learning (ARIMA, Prophet, LSTM, etc.).
  • Implementar algoritmos de boosting (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost) e árvores de decisão para diversas tarefas de aprendizado supervisionado.
  • Colaborar com engenheiros de dados e engenheiros de ML para implantar modelos em ambientes Azure e Databricks.
  • Realizar exploração de dados, engenharia de features e avaliação de modelos.
  • Apresentar descobertas e modelos de forma clara para públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre as mais recentes ferramentas e metodologias aplicadas em machine learning.

Requisitos:

  • Graduação ou Mestrado em Matemática, Estatística, Física ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência comprovada com sistemas de recomendação e modelos de séries temporais.
  • Sólido conhecimento em algoritmos de boosting e árvores de decisão.
  • Proficiência em Python e bibliotecas como scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, statsmodels.
  • Experiência com serviços em nuvem Azure e Databricks.
  • Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas e habilidade para trabalhar de forma independente.
  • Inglês fluente (oral e escrito).

title: Backend Developer, Brazil
description:
About Optibus:

Optibus is a unified software platform revolutionizing public transportation planning, scheduling, and operations in over 7,000 cities worldwide. Using AI, ML, and optimization algorithms, it empowers agencies to design more efficient, equitable, and sustainable transit networks, enhancing passenger access, reducing emissions, and improving driver conditions. With offices globally and a team of 350+ employees, Optibus fosters a collaborative culture centered on innovation, determination, and impact. As the first unicorn in public transportation technology, Optibus is driving the modernization of mass transit to make it the preferred choice for cities and passengers alike.


About the position:

As a Software Engineer in the CORD Team, you will be responsible for implementing all reports and integrations for customers. You will work closely with the various departments in the company including product, solutions, and other teams in the R&D. You will have a main role in onboarding all clients and therefore will have regular communication with customers.


Please apply your CV in English only!


Responsibilities:

  • Working closely with the team lead, and product manager in a cross-functional team currently consisting of developers
  • Closely collaborating with other teams in the R&D department across the organization
  • Take part in all aspects of the development cycle


Requirements:

  • B.Sc degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related domains
  • 5 years experience in hands-on backend development using Python. Alternatively using one or more of Java, C#, or similar language.
  • Experience in Agile Methodology.
  • A great team player and able to function in a fluid environment with minimal guidance and supervision It will be great if you have
  • Proficiency in English is a must.


Optibus is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire talented individuals, regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, ancestry, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, cultural background, religious beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. It is our responsibility at Optibus to provide an inclusive and accessible interview experience for all. We will provide reasonable accommodations for all candidates in need of individualised support during the hiring process.

title: Webflow Developer
description:
About you

You are someone who thrives in building scalable, high-impact solutions and who seeks to influence not just technology but also the direction of the product. You’re looking for a company where innovation and ownership go hand in hand, and where your contributions directly shape outcomes.


You bring to the team the following competencies:

  • 3+ years of experience in Webflow design and development.
  • Advanced JavaScript skills focused on accessibility and DOM manipulation.
  • Deep understanding of HTML / CSS
  • Experience with zapier is a plus but not 100% required.
  • Skilled in building reusable, accessible components and integrating CMS in Webflow.
  • Comfortable translating Figma designs into reusable, compliant Webflow components.
  • Strong attention to detail, problem-solving mindset, and collaborative approach.
  • Fluent English communication skills, working closely with US-based teams.


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Apply JavaScript and DOM customizations to resolve accessibility issues.
  • Handle ad-hoc tickets from the marketing team, including Website copy updates and Implementing new page layouts based on provided design.
  • Build and modify Webflow pages using the Webflow CMS.
  • Collaborate with our in-house design team to implement responsive and accessible designs.
  • Implement interactive elements (e.g., lightboxes, sliders, animations) using JavaScript when necessary.
  • Occasionally support email template creation/testing using tools like Customer.io (prior experience not required).


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: Backend Engineer (AWS | Kotlin/Go) SR
description:
Conhecimentos Técnicos necessários (Hard Skills)

  • AWS (nível médio a profundo) : experiência sólida com serviços como Lambda, Step Functions, DynamoDB, SNS/SQS , além de capacidade de aprender rapidamente serviços novos (ex.: Kinesis).
  • Linguagens :
  • Kotlin (versão 17) – principal linguagem utilizada em aplicações de mensageria e regras de negócio.
  • Go (Golang) – utilizada em aplicações de processo.
  • Java – vivência sólida (mín. 6 anos) é aceitável como base, devido à proximidade com Kotlin.
  • Mensageria e Eventos : noções de Kafka (streams, consumo/produção de eventos).
  • Banco de Dados : experiência com DynamoDB .
  • Testes Automatizados : não precisa codar em Python, mas deve ter conhecimento básico para apoiar QAs em testes integrados.
  • Observabilidade : experiência com interpretação de logs, monitoração e troubleshooting .
  • Ferramentas de Observabilidade/Diferenciais : conhecimento em CloudWatch e Datadog (forte diferencial).

title: Desenvolvedor Java Sênior
description:
Se você busca uma oportunidade na área de Tecnologia da Informação, tem organização, boa comunicação e vontade de crescer, essa vaga 100% remoto e CLT, pode ser para você.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência sólida com Java;
  • Experiência com React, Angular, SpringBoot;
  • Experiência com GIT, HTML, Javascript, MySql ou outro banco de dados;
  • Experiência com REST, Scrum, SOAP, Typescript;
  • Jenkins, JIRA será um diferencial;
  • Idioma Inglês Avançado (terá inteirações internacionais).


Responsabilidades:

Como Desenvolvedor Java Sênior na T-Systems, o profissional será responsável por projetar, desenvolver e manter aplicações robustas, seguras e escaláveis, alinhadas às necessidades de negócio dos nossos clientes. Atuará em todas as etapas do ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de software, desde a análise e compreensão dos requisitos até o deploy em ambientes produtivos e sustentação de aplicações em operação, contribuindo com decisões de arquitetura e definição de padrões de desenvolvimento. Será também responsável por construir e manter integrações entre sistema. Além disso, colaborará com equipes multidisciplinares em ambientes ágeis, interagindo com analistas, arquitetos, testers e outros desenvolvedores para promover entregas contínuas de valor. Espera-se ainda que contribua com o monitoramento da performance das aplicações, proponha melhorias técnicas e participe ativamente de iniciativas de inovação e modernização de sistemas legados


O que oferecemos:

  • Ambiente colaborativo e multicultural.
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento profissional em uma das líderes globais em tecnologia.
  • Pacote de benefícios completo CLT - PLR, VR, Previdência, Gympass, Convênio médico e Odonto e etc.

title: Senior Front-End Software Engineer
description:
Senior Front-End Software Engineer (React.js)

We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Front-End Software Engineer with at least 5 years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and experience with GraphQL.

In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and UI scaffolding to ensure an optimal user experience.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI and full-stack engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, enhance grid health, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders of Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities operate and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development : Work closely with UI/UX designers to build, implement, and maintain scalable front-end applications, ensuring delivery of unparalleled user experiences
  • Architecture : Lead front-end architectural decisions, implementing best practices in performance optimization and responsive design
  • Leadership : Provide leadership within the development team, fostering a learning and growth environment
  • System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments utilizing React.js
  • Experience with GraphQL
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience with Python, Golang, Node.js, or Java
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are committed to delivering world-class remote resources that enable our valued client team members to work effectively. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
Sobre Verde Credit

  • Tecnologia: familiaridade básica com ferramentas digitais e disposição para aprender rapidamente CRM e plataformas de prospecção.

Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)

  • Experiência anterior em atendimento, suporte, telemarketing, inside sales ou funções comerciais.

  • Interesse pelo setor financeiro, fintechs ou produtos para PMEs.

title: React Tech Lead - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for React Tech Leads to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Build a framework for other developers to build applications with. Initially focusing on building reactive dashboards with an option to make mobile versions of them.

- Assist in coaching and mentoring other React developers.


Requirements:


- 7+ years of experience in Front End development with strong skills in Javascript, CSS3 and HTML5.

- 2+ of experience developing Web applications using ReactJS, Flux, Redux, Relay, etc.

- Experience using ES2015 (ES6 / ES7).

- Experience with command lines, APIs, and client-side performance.

- Familiar with the concepts of basic programming, JavaScript and data structures, types of variables and idiosyncrasies.

- Comfortable using debuggers and code tracking.

- Proven experience in the use of Jasmine or similar tools for Front End testing.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Python Engineer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


Step into the world of software innovation as our Python Engineer, where you'll craft robust applications using cutting-edge Python technologies. This isn't just about coding - it's about designing sophisticated solutions, making architectural decisions, and creating high-impact software that solves complex business challenges.


Key responsibilities:


- Design and develop powerful applications and services using Python.

- Implement sophisticated features and integrate with diverse systems and APIs.

- Create efficient, maintainable, and reusable code following industry best practices.

- Engage in code reviews and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

- Collaborate with team members to overcome technical challenges.

- Guide junior developers and share expertise across the team.


Requirements:


- 3+ years of experience in Python development.

- Proven track record with APIs and Web Services.

- Experience working with database technologies.

- Advanced understanding of algorithms and data structures.

- Basic knowledge of IT infrastructure.

- Experience designing and implementing real-world software modules.

- Proficiency in writing and implementing unit tests.

- Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines.

- Advanced English proficiency.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: SALES ASSISTANT (Inglês Fluente)
description:
Sales Assistant (Fluent English) | 100% Remote


At Blue Dot BPO, a Brazilian outsourcing company, we connect LATAM talent with top North American clients. Were looking for energetic, motivated professionals ready to grow their careers in international sales.


What We Offer

  • R$3,500/month
  • 100% remote direct contact with the U.S. market
  • Intensive, paid training in B2B sales
  • Long-term contract + real career growth opportunities
  • Monday to Friday, 1221h BRT (aligned with U.S. business hours)


What Youll Do

  • Support outbound prospecting campaigns (cold calls, emails, LinkedIn)
  • Assist in qualifying B2B leads and maintaining the sales pipeline
  • Support sales agendas, meetings, and materials
  • Collaborate on proposals and sales presentations
  • Conduct market research to identify trends and competitors
  • Use prospecting and CRM tools (HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, etc.)


What Were Looking For

  • Fluent English (C1/C2) daily contact with U.S. clients
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Resilient, charismatic, and results-driven profile
  • Willingness to handle high volumes of outreach in a dynamic environment


Nice to Have

  • Experience with CRM and prospecting tools
  • Previous experience in cold calling or outbound sales
  • Dynamic, charismatic, and fast learner
  • Consistent record of exceeding targets will be a plus


️ Tech Setup

  • 2 monitors | i7 processor (or equivalent) | 12GB+ RAM
  • Headset with microphone | High-speed internet
  • Quiet, interruption-free workspace


Work directly with the U.S. market, earn in reais and dollars, and take the next step in your international sales career!

️Apply now and be part of Blue Dot BPO:

title: Contract Specialist - English & Spanish-
description:
THIS IS A ROLE FOR SOMEONE OPEN TO WORK AS A CONSULTANT FREELANCER LONG TERM FOR TOP PLAYER IN MEDICAL DEVICES.


Do you have a first experience in contracting activities for clinical trials ? Are you enthusiastic about clinical trial contracts, budgeting and site negotiation ? You like working in a dynamic, international environment where your strong analytical and communication skills will be of good use? Then this may be the opportunity for you.


Job Description


The Contract Specialist is responsible for contract management, including all operational and administrative functions of the contract. Focus is mainly on clinical trial agreements.


Responsibilities

  • Handle the end-to-end process related to clinical trial agreements (draft, review, negotiation, finalization).
  • Ensure compliance throughout the process
  • Liaise with site staff, study team, Legal and Finance departments
  • Keep relevant systems up-to-date


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Law or Science
  • A first experience in clinical research and clinical trial agreements in US
  • Sense of accuracy and precision
  • Pro-active
  • Stress-resistant
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills
  • Strong organization and time management skills
  • Ability to effectively manage parallel priorities
  • The existing right to work in Europe

Benefits

  • Fulltime, remote position
  • 18 months mission with high chance of extension

title: Senior DevOps / LLM Engineer
description:
Description

We’re seeking an experienced Dev/LLMOps Engineer to design, deploy, and maintain the infrastructure supporting Large Language Model (LLM) platforms. This role blends DevOps best practices with AI/ML expertise, with a focus on building and scaling agentic AI systems that integrate directly with LLMs. You’ll drive development of intelligent, autonomous agents while ensuring reliability, scalability, and performance across training, fine-tuning, and deployment pipelines.


English fluency is a MUST for this role! Only candidates with level C1 or C2 will be considered:


  • A1 Beginner
  • A2 Elementary
  • B1 Intermediate
  • B2 Upper-Intermediate
  • C1 Advanced
  • C2 Proficient


Responsibilities

  • Own strategy and execution of agentic AI systems using LLMs and autonomous decision-making components
  • Build prototypes and scale them into MVPs demonstrating real-world AI viability
  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to embed LLM agents into user-facing features
  • Design and manage CI/CD pipelines for LLM training and deployment workflows
  • Provide technical leadership on DevOps, security, and deployment strategies for AI/ML models


Requirements

  • 5+ years building and deploying ML or GenAI systems in production, with strong architectural and systems-level ownership
  • 2+ years of proven experience with LLM integration, LLM-based agents, or autonomous reasoning systems
  • End-to-end AI/ML delivery: data prep, training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring
  • Cloud expertise (AWS, GCP, or Azure) with CI/CD pipelines, multi-tenant deployments, and infrastructure automation
  • Experience with Databricks and familiarity with Langchain / GenAI toolkits
  • Strong agility and ability to deliver in fast-moving product environments


Nice To Have

  • Advanced degree (MS/Ph.D.) in ML, Computer Science, or related field
  • Deep expertise in DevOps/MLOps practices and scaling secure, enterprise-grade AI workflows
  • Broader data engineering knowledge, especially in Databricks
  • Background in aviation industry

title: Android Engineer
description:
Pride Global is hiring an Android Engineer in Brazil. Please apply for consideration!!


Location: Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: Temporary.


Job summary:

We’re looking for a skilled developer to help expand our global reach through high-quality Android features and seamless internationalization.

As part of our mobile engineering team, you’ll work across the full development lifecycle—owning features from concept to launch, collaborating with designers and backend engineers, and contributing to a platform used by millions. Your work will directly influence how guests engage with our platform around the world.


What You’ll Do

  • Develop, maintain, and support Android features and functionality
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams on new features and visual design enhancements
  • Perform thorough code reviews and uphold best practices
  • Own your tasks from start to finish, communicating progress and blockers clearly
  • Manage your workload using Jira and stay organized in a fast-paced environment


What We’re Looking For

  • Professional English fluency (written and spoken)
  • 4+ years of software engineering experience building Android applications at scale
  • Strong skills in Kotlin or Java
  • Experience with Jetpack Compose and Kotlin Coroutines
  • Working knowledge of GraphQL
  • Backend experience (APIs, databases, Kubernetes) is a plus
  • Ability to thrive independently in a remote team setting
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

description:
Sobre a Arkama

Na Arkama, acreditamos no poder da criatividade, inovação e inteligência artificial para transformar o mercado de pagamentos.

Somos uma fintech em crescimento acelerado, com a missão de empoderar empreendedores digitais através de soluções simples, seguras e eficientes.


Estamos expandindo nosso time e buscamos um Desenvolvedor Backend Sênior especializado em PHP/Laravel que também tenha habilidade em aplicar IA no desenvolvimento , trazendo agilidade e segurança para nossos projetos.



O que buscamos em você:


  • PHP/Laravel : Domínio sólido em PHP orientado a objetos e experiência avançada em Laravel.
  • Experiência : Pelo menos 5 anos atuando como Backend.
  • Controle de Versão : GIT ou SVN.
  • APIs RESTFUL : Criação e consumo eficientes.
  • Banco de Dados : MySQL (tabelas, views, stored procedures, queries otimizadas).

  • Segurança : Atenção a práticas seguras em APIs, autenticação e transações.
  • IA aplicada ao desenvolvimento : Capacidade de usar ferramentas de IA para acelerar entrega, gerar código com qualidade e automatizar processos.


Diferenciais:


  • Conhecimentos em Livewire v3, Filament v3, AlpineJS, Google Cloud, AWS, VueJS e Tailwind CSS.
  • Experiência com integração de APIs de pagamentos e sistemas financeiros.

. Agilidade e entregas rápidas utilizando IA com qualidade , acelerando o desenvolvimento sem abrir mão da segurança e das boas práticas.




O que oferecemos:


  • Contratação PJ com autonomia e flexibilidade.
  • Trabalho 100% Remoto .
  • Salário Competitivo , alinhado ao mercado.
  • Day Off no aniversário .

title: Motion Graphics Video Editor
description:
Join Manukora, the #1 D2C Manuka Business in the USA.

Are you someone who thrives on taking charge, driving results, and staying steps ahead? Do you excel in fast-paced settings and possess an intuitive ability to understand and fulfill the needs of a dynamic team? If this resonates with you, an exciting opportunity awaits!


We’re looking for a creative, data-savvy, and proactive Video Editor to craft high-performing social media content for our fast-growing brand. This role is fully remote, with preference for some overlap with PST working hours. You’ll be at the heart of Manukora’s storytelling engine — transforming briefs into thumb-stopping, results-driven content for multiple social platforms.


This is a high-trust, high-autonomy position suited for someone who’s self-directed, obsessed with craft, and energized by creative momentum.


What You’ll Do

  • Create compelling, high-performance social media ads that align with creative briefs and drive measurable results
  • Design dynamic motion graphics, text animations, and visual effects that enhance storytelling and brand messaging
  • Collaborate closely with strategists, creative leads, and editors to optimize video and graphics content tailored for social platforms
  • Apply performance insights and creative feedback to continually refine and elevate ad effectiveness
  • Take creative ownership of projects while remaining highly receptive to feedback and iteration
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously with strong attention to detail, ensuring deadlines and quality standards are consistently met
  • Maintain organized and efficient Adobe project files


What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of professional experience creating engaging digital content for social media platforms
  • Expert-level Adobe Premiere Pro skills with a strong foundation in storytelling and pacing
  • Intermediate+ Adobe After Effects proficiency (motion graphics, kinetic typography, and visual effects)
  • Deep understanding of social media optimization and platform-specific best practices
  • Excellent English communication skills (written & verbal) for effective collaboration with international teams
  • Quick learner who thrives on feedback, adapts rapidly to new challenges, and takes ownership of creative work
  • Proven ability to work independently in a fast-paced, results-driven environment


Bonus Points For

  • Experience with AI-powered creative tools (Midjourney, RunwayML, Adobe Firefly, etc.)
  • Digital advertising agency or performance marketing experience
  • Proven track record optimizing video content for social media algorithms
  • Experience with Adobe Creative Cloud Libraries and collaborative workflows
  • Background in data-driven creative optimization


Details

  • Role Type: Full-time, Remote
  • Location: Open — at least partial overlap with PST preferred
  • Start Date: ASAP


How to Apply

Send us an email at with:

  • A few lines about what excites you about this role
  • Your resume
  • A link to your portfolio showcasing your best work


Email Only: Please note, we’re all about direct connections. Make sure to send your application via email.

title: English Teacher
description:
Descrição da Empresa Empresa com cerca de 100 alunos, níveis básico, intermediário e avançado.


Descrição do Cargo Estamos buscando um Professor de Inglês para se juntar à nossa equipe em um formato de contrato. Este papel é focado em oferecer aulas de inglês online, planejando e preparando lições eficazes que atendam às necessidades dos alunos. As responsabilidades diárias incluem desenvolver materiais didáticos, avaliar o progresso dos estudantes e fornecer feedback construtivo. Este é um cargo remoto, permitindo que você trabalhe de qualquer lugar.

Qualificações

  • Ensino de Inglês: Necessário possuir experiência em ensino de inglês, com conhecimento das melhores práticas pedagógicas.
  • Planejamento de Aulas: Habilidades em planejar e organizar, de forma online, lições de forma eficaz e criativa para maximizar o aprendizado dos alunos.
  • Educação e Ensino: Formação e experiência em educação e ensino são essenciais para garantir a qualidade das aulas ministradas.
  • Comunicação: Habilidades de comunicação clara e eficaz, tanto verbalmente quanto por escrito, são essenciais para garantir a interação produtiva entre os alunos.
  • Além das habilidades acima, será considerado um diferencial a fluência em outros idiomas e a capacidade de utilizar plataformas digitais de ensino.

title: Business Director
description:
Why Join Us?

  • Competitive salary
  • Private health insurance and paid vacation benefits
  • Senior leadership role with high visibility and direct impact across Latin America
  • Opportunity to represent an established global iGaming company at events, exhibitions, and partner meetings


Who Will You Work For?

A leading international iGaming provider with a strong presence across multiple regions, now expanding its commercial leadership in Latin America. The company is committed to innovation, strategic growth, and building long-term partnerships in the online gaming space.

With a portfolio that includes top-performing slot game products, the company is trusted by partners worldwide for delivering engaging, high-quality solutions. As part of its LatAm expansion, we’re seeking a Business Director / Manager in Brazil to drive strategic partnerships, lead the team, and grow the company’s influence in the region.


Why This Role?

As the Business Director / Manager, you’ll be the driving force behind expanding and strengthening B2B partnerships across Brazil and Latin America. You will lead negotiations, shape go-to-market strategies, and ensure seamless execution of commercial projects.

This role is ideal for a commercially driven leader with an established network in the iGaming industry, strong knowledge of the Brazilian and LatAm markets, and the ambition to grow business relationships in a highly competitive space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Expand and negotiate B2B iGaming partnerships across Brazil and Latin America
  • Identify potential partners and adjust strategies based on market changes and opportunities
  • Plan and execute integrated online and offline marketing campaigns
  • Analyze market trends, competitors, and player behaviors to provide actionable insights
  • Promote slot game products effectively to partners, designing tailored solutions when needed
  • Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth project execution and delivery
  • Stay current with Latin American market dynamics and gaming regulations
  • Represent the company at industry exhibitions and events to build brand influence
  • Lead and motivate a regional team to enhance efficiency and performance


Requirements:

  • Must be based in Brazil (Brazilian nationality preferred)
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese (Spanish is a plus)
  • Established network/resources in the B2B iGaming industry within Latin America
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience at a large B2B iGaming company in the region
  • Proven experience in partnership expansion, commercial negotiations, and market strategy
  • Strong communication, coordination, and cross-cultural skills
  • Willingness to travel occasionally across the region
  • Leadership and management experience is an advantage


Benefits:

  • High-impact, senior-level role with ownership of LatAm growth strategy
  • Exposure to international markets and opportunities to represent the brand globally

title: Administrative Assistant – Service Auditing
description:
About the Role


We are a California-based American company looking for an Administrative Assistant (entry level) based in Brazil to work 100% remotely. This is an operational position focused on ensuring the quality of our services through daily photo audits, contractor communication, and KPI reporting. We are looking for professionals who are comfortable working in an operational capacity.


Key Responsibilities


  • Photo Audits: Review and audit service photos in real time and on the following day to ensure compliance with quality standards.
  • Feedback to Contractors: Send daily feedback to contractors and technicians highlighting missing elements, improvement points, and corrective actions.
  • Rework Tracking: Maintain a board of services that were reworked or required follow-up, ensuring transparency and accountability.
  • KPI & Weekly Reporting: Compile and send weekly reports with key indicators such as punctuality, number of completed jobs, and quantity of redos.
  • Field Leader Communication: Liaise with the Field Leader in California to share clear, actionable feedback and improvement opportunities.
  • End-of-Day Report: Prepare and send a daily report identifying missing or incomplete photos.


Requirements


  • Fluent English (written and spoken).
  • Administrative experience with strong attention to detail.
  • Availability to work during California business hours:
  • Monday to Friday: 3:00 PM – 12:00 AM (Brasília time).
  • Saturday: 8:00 PM – 12:00 AM (Brasília time).
  • Must be legally able to work as an Independent Contractor (PJ) in Brazil .
  • Willingness to follow the California calendar (holidays only observed when in the U.S.).


Preferred Qualifications


  • Previous experience in auditing, quality control, or verification of information .
  • Familiarity with KPI reporting or operational dashboards.


Soft Skills


  • Strong multitasking abilities and capacity to absorb new processes quickly.
  • Dynamic and proactive , able to adapt and prioritize in a fast-paced environment.
  • Tech-savvy , with ease in using systems and technology to improve processes and make work faster and easier.


Contract


  • Contract Type: Independent Contractor (PJ).


Ideal Candidate


  • We are seeking a detail-oriented professional based in Brazil who enjoys operational work, can handle multiple tasks, communicates clearly, and leverages technology to improve processes.

title: Gerente Técnico de Inteligência Artificial - Brasil
description:
Você na Deloitte

Você terá a oportunidade de evoluir sua carreira na maior organização de serviços profissionais do mundo atuando como Gerente Técnico de Inteligência Artificial, no time de Artificial Intelligence & Data. Na sua rotina, você irá:

  • Liderar a definição de arquiteturas de referência para soluções de IA, Machine Learning, LLMs e Visão Computacional , considerando boas práticas de escalabilidade, segurança e governança.
  • Atuar como referência técnica para equipes de cientistas de dados, engenheiros de dados e desenvolvedores, apoiando decisões de design e implementação.
  • Participar ativamente em propostas comerciais , trazendo visão técnica para novos negócios e validando a viabilidade de soluções junto a clientes.
  • Conduzir revisões técnicas de código, modelos e pipelines , garantindo qualidade, performance e aderência às normas regulatórias e éticas.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de Pesquisa & Desenvolvimento (P&D) para novos produtos e soluções proprietárias em IA.
  • Interagir com stakeholders de alto nível (C-level, diretores, gerentes de tecnologia e negócios), traduzindo desafios estratégicos em soluções técnicas viáveis.
  • Atuar como mentor na evolução técnica da equipe, promovendo capacitação em ferramentas modernas de IA, MLOps e Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) .

Os líderes da Deloitte vivem o nosso propósito: gerar impactos positivos. Energizam, empoderam, conectam, interagem, reagem e pensam de formas diferentes. Por isso, buscamos pessoas que são inspiradoras, criam ambientes diversos, influenciam uma cultura colaborativa e, com isso, entregam valor. Nossa liderança é peça-chave para o nosso crescimento.

Acreditamos na força dos talentos que preparamos. Eles transformam de fato, impactam organizações, impulsionam mais talentos e criam oportunidades. Que tal fazer parte da maior organização de serviços profissionais do mundo? Escolha seu impacto.


O que precisa para você se candidatar à vaga?

- Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Matemática, Estatística ou áreas correlatas.

- Experiência comprovada em liderança técnica de projetos de inteligência artificial ou ciência de dados em consultoria ou grandes empresas.

- Conhecimento avançado em Python , frameworks de IA/ML (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Hugging Face) e bibliotecas para NLP e CV.

- Domínio de arquiteturas de LLMs e RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) , pipelines de MLOps e boas práticas de implantação em produção.

- Experiência em cloud computing (GCP, AWS ou Azure) e computação paralela.

- Forte habilidade de comunicação e capacidade de interagir com clientes de diferentes níveis de maturidade tecnológica.

-Inglês fluente.

O que estará disponível para você?

Desenvolvimento profissional

É claro que cuidaríamos do seu desenvolvimento aqui na Deloitte! Queremos que você alcance seus objetivos profissionais e pessoais e, por isso, contamos com Universidade Corporativa, acesso a plataformas online de aprendizado, plataforma de idiomas com mais de 7.500 conteúdos e cerca de 60 cursos divididos por nível, área de atuação, habilidades profissionais e interesses, e até uma plataforma que reúne diversas instituições de ensino, fornecendo descontos exclusivos para profissionais Deloitte e seus dependentes.

Além disso, oferecemos um plano de carreira estruturado, com mentoria de profissionais da Deloitte por meio de um(a) coach, que poderá ouvir seus desafios e apoiar para que consiga evoluir tanto com habilidades técnicas, quanto com habilidades comportamentais com base na própria experiência. É ótimo ter uma pessoa mentora, não é mesmo?

Cuidados com o seu bem-estar

Aqui na Deloitte, acreditamos que saúde e bem-estar não são apenas projetos, e sim uma mudança de cultura. Queremos que você coloque em prática todo o seu talento e desenvolva uma carreira de sucesso com a gente, com equilíbrio entre Mente, Corpo e Propósito. Para isso, contamos com mais de 30 benefícios, como:

  • Serviço de telemedicina para que você consiga fazer uma pré-avaliação sem precisar sair de casa!
  • Family Strategy: programa destinados à profissionais gestantes e futuros papais que terão todo apoio possível neste momento tão especial
  • Wellhub (Gympass) para colocar os exercícios físicos em dia
  • Dia de folga no mês do seu aniversário, para celebrar uma das pessoas mais importantes de sua vida
  • Canal de apoio psicológico e Serviço Social

(Mais) Benefícios

  • Assistência médica e odontológica! Para que você faça check-ups e cuide de você, em primeiro lugar*
  • Participação nos lucros. Afinal, sem os nossos talentos, não poderíamos crescer exponencialmente
  • Auxílio-internet, para apoiar no trabalho em modelo híbrido
  • Seguro de vida
  • Cartão Multibenefícios*

*Você receberá um valor em seu cartão e poderá distribuí-lo entre as opções que melhor se adequam às suas necessidades de acordo com as regras do programa.

Oportunidade de fazer parte de uma cultura inclusiva na Deloitte Brasil

Você pode ser quem realmente é com oportunidade igual de crescimento. Para reforçar esse compromisso, desenvolvemos a estratégia global D&I com os 5 pilares – Origens, Delas, LGBT+, Inclui e Gerações. Destacamos que todas as nossas vagas estão abertas ao público PcD.

Esperamos você neste time!

Você pode ser quem realmente é com oportunidade igual de crescimento. Para reforçar esse compromisso, desenvolvemos a estratégia global D&I com os 5 pilares – Origens, Delas, LGBT+, Inclui e Gerações. Destacamos que todas as nossas vagas estão abertas ao público PcD.

Esperamos você neste time!

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
About us


At Softbinator Technologies , we’re driven by innovation and excellence. As an engineer here, you’ll be working on high-impact projects that challenge the status quo and push the boundaries of technology. This is a place where you’ll tackle real-world problems , collaborate with exceptionally talented engineers , and build cutting-edge solutions that have a tangible impact.

We’re entering a new era of software development where engineers don’t just write code - they orchestrate, prompt, and collaborate with AI to build faster, better, and more creatively than ever before.

We're not just embracing AI - we're building with it, around it, and through it.


What we are looking for


A UiPath Support Engineer with solid experience in managing and optimising automation solutions. You’re someone who thrives in service-oriented environments, understands ITIL-driven processes, and brings both technical know-how and a customer-first approach.


With these skills, you are our perfect match


  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • At least 2+ years of hands-on experience with UiPath Studio, Assistant, and Orchestrator.
  • Proven background in incident, change, and problem management .
  • Strong technical skills in C# or VB.NET, SQL, REST APIs .
  • Familiarity with Jira, ServiceNow, or other ticketing platforms .
  • Understanding of UiPath platform infrastructure (e.g., Orchestrator setup, robot provisioning).
  • Ability to troubleshoot efficiently, prioritize requests, and deliver timely resolutions.
  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken.
  • Collaborative mindset, customer orientation, and adaptability.
  • It is a plus if you have experience with UiPath advanced features such as Document Understanding, AI Center, Action Center, or Process Mining .
  • Relevant exposure to enterprise-level support or managed services environments is preferable, but not mandatory
  • Knowledge of VBA and Microsoft Office automation is also a plus.


  • Agile mindset: proactive, communicative, and capable of delivering value in incremental steps.
  • Strong verbal and written English communication skills.


How you’ll drive success

  • Ensure seamless operation of production automations by providing L1/L2/L3 support .
  • Continuously monitor bot’s performance and availability, addressing issues proactively.
  • Respond to incidents and requests in line with ITIL best practices .
  • Implement small enhancements and ensure solutions remain robust, reusable, and scalable.
  • Partner with business users to troubleshoot issues and roll out improvements.
  • Keep documentation updated and processes refined for smooth support operations.
  • Act as the bridge between automation developers, business stakeholders, and operations teams.

title: Agente de Viagens com Português Avançado + Amadeus
description:
Sobre a Boostomer


A Boostomer é uma Agência de Experiência do Cliente com sede em Barcelona, que oferece serviços de consultoria e terceirização para empresas emergentes e em expansão.


Descrição

Um dos nossos clientes é uma empresa especializada em serviços de atendimento ao cliente para agências de viagens, operando na Espanha e em Portugal. Nossa equipe atua no suporte a viajantes corporativos fora do horário comercial, garantindo um atendimento de alta qualidade em momentos críticos.


O que estamos buscando?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Agente de Viagens com experiência em reservas e suporte a clientes corporativos, com disponibilidade para atuar em turnos noturnos e nos fins de semana. Se você é organizado(a), autônomo(a) e com habilidades em resolução de problemas, queremos te conhecer!


Você é a pessoa ideal se:

✅ Fala português em nível avançado (não consideramos nível intermediário).

✅ Tem experiência avançada comprovada com o sistema Amadeus.

✅ É autônomo(a), resolutivo(a) e capaz de lidar com emergências.

✅ Tem experiência em gestão de reservas, alterações e suporte a viajantes corporativos.


Responsabilidades:

Oferecer suporte a viajantes corporativos em situações de emergência.

Gerenciar reservas e alterações usando sistemas como Amadeus.

Resolver incidentes de forma eficiente, garantindo uma experiência fluida ao cliente.


⏰ Horário e disponibilidade:

Todos os turnos serão informados com pelo menos 1 mês de antecedência. Horários abaixo expressos em hora da Argentina.

  • De segunda a sexta-feira: das 02h às 04h (madrugada)
  • Fins de semana: 10 horas divididas entre sábado e domingo, ou concentradas em um único dia. Faixa de horário: das 03h às 19h.

Exemplo 1 – dividido: sábado das 14h às 19h e domingo das 14h às 19h

Exemplo 2 – concentrado em 1 dia: das 09h às 19h ou das 03h às 13h

Excepcionalmente, pode haver necessidade de um turno vespertino das 13h às 19h.

Observação: a partir de março/abril, haverá mudança de horário na Espanha (adiantamento de 1 hora).


Benefícios:

  • Pagamento por hora em USD, conforme sua experiência e habilidades
  • Participação em um projeto com grande projeção e crescimento
  • Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e colaborativo
  • Treinamento 100% pago
  • Modalidade 100% remota


Previsão de início: Julho de 2025


Requisitos técnicos:

  • Computador: processador Core i5 (7ª geração ou superior), ou equivalente, com no mínimo 8 GB de RAM
  • Armazenamento: mínimo de 256 GB SSD ou 500 GB HDD
  • Internet: velocidade mínima de 25 Mbps (upload e download)
  • Sistema operacional: Windows original
  • Áudio: fones de ouvido com cancelamento de ruído
  • Vídeo: notebook/PC com webcam ou câmera de boa qualidade

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
Who we are:


TrueBuilt is the construction industry's first computer vision powered, end-to-end Preconstruction software for specialty contractors and general contractors. Our patent-pending computer vision takeoff solutions decrease time spent on quantity takeoff and cost estimation by 200%. Our AI Document Assistant, Flexible Estimation Engine and Bid Management modules supercharge builders to mitigate risk and win new bids at scale. Trusted by the ENR 400 and 600, TrueBuilt offers unparalleled flexibility, seamlessly integrating with existing solutions or serving as a comprehensive standalone platform.


Requirements:


  • Bachelor's degree
  • Proven experience in sales or account management.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as a part of a team.
  • Strong negotiation and problem-solving skills.
  • Knowledge of CRM software (Hubspot).
  • Proven ability to achieve quota targets.
  • Extensive cold calling experience is a must.
  • Ability to work 9 AM – 5 PM, USA Central Time.
  • Flexibility to follow the U.S. holiday calendar.


Preferred Qualifications:


  • Prior employment at Construction SaaS or Vertical SaaS Company.
  • Comfortable with remote work.


Responsibilities:


  • Main focus on cold calling prospective clients.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with new clients.
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities.
  • Create and execute sales strategies to meet or exceed targets.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure client satisfaction and project success.
  • Prepare and deliver sales presentations and proposals.
  • Negotiate contracts and pricing with clients.
  • Continuously improve knowledge of products, services, and industry trends to provide the best solutions to clients.


Benefits:


  • Competitive salary in USD
  • Unlimited PTO.
  • A buttoned-down work culture—professional, respectful, and collaborative.
  • Opportunity to be part of an industry-changing startup that’s redefining construction technology.

title: Appointment Setter
description:
(Remote | Full-Time | US Hours)


If you're persuasive, people-savvy, and energized by outreach—this role is for you.

We’re looking for a highly motivated Appointment Setter to identify and engage leads across LinkedIn and email, book discovery calls, and fuel our sales pipeline. You’ll be the first human touchpoint in our sales process—and a critical part of our growth engine.


What You’ll Do:

  • Source and qualify leads based on clear criteria
  • Cold message and follow up with prospects via LinkedIn and email
  • Book discovery calls and free audits for our sales team
  • Manage and update your sales funnel daily
  • Collaborate with leadership on scripts and outreach improvements
  • Maintain records and report progress to your supervisor
  • Hit daily/weekly goals while staying human and consultative


What We’re Looking For:

  • 1+ year experience in appointment setting or online sales
  • Excellent written and verbal communication
  • Familiarity with funnel management and CRM systems
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • A consultative, value-driven approach to outreach
  • Comfortable working 9–5 PM EST (remote, full-time)
  • At least B2-level conversational English


100% remote, collaborative environment

High autonomy, low bureaucracy

Entrepreneurial team—many of us run our own Amazon brands

Learn from experts in digital marketing, PPC, and Amazon strategy

Use our tools to grow your own side business

title: Supply Chain Analyst - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Supply Chain Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.


Key responsibilities:


- Determine supply needs for products and services and research potential suppliers.

- Act as a link and communicate pricing and performance needs to vendors and suppliers.

- Participate in negotiations of favorable procurement contracts and prices with selected vendors and suppliers.

- Select the most suitable suppliers in terms of reliability, product quality, and cost-efficiency.

- Maintain and update a list of suppliers and their qualifications, delivery times, and potential future development.

- Prepare cost-benefit analysis reports for review by managers.


Requirements:


- 2+ years of experience in a supply management role or related position.

- Knowledge of SAP or SAP B1.

- Degree in supply chain management, logistics, business management, or related fields.

- Experience in managing inventory.

- Proficiency in SQL analysis tools and mathematical analysis.

- Interpersonal skills and ability to build and improve trust.

- Advanced level of English.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Business Intelligence Analyst - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Business Intelligence Analyst to join our team. This professional will be responsible for taking raw information – numbers or qualitative data sets – and constructing narratives that help our business colleagues to make better decisions. The primary goal of this position is to take large volumes of complex data, extract insights, and help solve problems.


Key responsibilities:


- Work with stakeholders to understand reporting needs, identifying and querying data sources to get the required data.

- Cleanse and massage data into the shape required, creating Tableau datasets, reports, and dashboards to meet requirements.

- Present and gather feedback from stakeholders on the finished product.

- Deploy data, reports, and dashboards to Tableau; develop reports according to analyst-defined specifications

- Conduct technical training.

- Maintain and document the operational environment.

- Maintain and process SQL Server SPs and queries.


Requirements:


- At least 3 years of experience developing Business Intelligence dashboards and reports, analyzing, and visualizing data.

- An understanding of Tableau administration, licensing, security, and deployment, and at least 1 year of previous work experience using Tableau.

- A solid understanding of the concepts involved in modeling relational data.

- Strong analytic skills, with a hands-on approach with the ability to deliver commitments.

- Superior organizational skills, with a disciplined approach to implementation, support, and documentation.

- Experience with ETL of data from a variety of sources using SSIS, Python, or similar technologies (is a plus).

- Knowledge of SQL Server database architecture (components and processes of the database) and/or experience with creating tabular data models in SQL Server (is a plus).

- Advanced English level.

title: ASP.Net Lead Architect / Sr. Developer
description:
Job description


  • Full Time
  • Remote


About the Role

Company is seeking a highly experienced ASP.NET Lead Architect / Senior Developer to join our team. This role is ideal for a deeply technical professional with proven experience in designing, optimizing, and maintaining high-performance systems within the .NET 5 and Azure ecosystem. You will play a critical role in ensuring scalability, cost efficiency, and top-tier performance of our technology stack while leading the development of new features and delivering timely bug fixes.

This is a highly technical role, requiring advanced problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to mentor and guide peers in best practices.


Responsibilities

  • Architecture & Optimization
  • Revamp and fine-tune our ASP.NET web application stack for performance, cost effectiveness, and scalability .
  • Design and optimize high-performance API services , proxy technologies , and multi-tenant database infrastructures .
  • Development
  • Build new features across backend, web, and mobile applications.
  • Ensure clean, maintainable, and scalable code with strong adherence to standards.
  • Support legacy Xamarin components where necessary.
  • Maintenance & Operations
  • Quickly troubleshoot and fix bugs.
  • Oversee CI/CD pipelines to ensure smooth deployments.
  • Work with monitoring and observability tools to maintain system health.
  • Collaboration
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams (product, QA, DevOps).
  • Communicate clearly in English (spoken and written) with stakeholders across geographies.
  • Handle “overly confident developers” tactfully, ensuring technical transparency and simplicity.


Tech Stack

Programming Languages

  • C# / .NET 5 / ASP.NET Core – Core backend services, API layer, and daemon services
  • TypeScript + Angular – Shopify embedded apps, admin portal, CRM features
  • React Native (JavaScript/TypeScript) – Mobile apps (iOS/Android, offline capabilities)
  • Liquid – Shopify storefront & embedded UI integration
  • XML – Domain modeling + code generation workflows
  • SQL (T-SQL) – Azure SQL Server (master + tenant databases)
  • NoSQL (CosmosDB / MongoDB API) – Operational data, caching, and sync storage

Frameworks & Libraries

  • .NET 5 – Services and APIs
  • Xamarin.Forms – Legacy mobile components
  • Entity Framework Core – ORM for SQL backends
  • Mermaid – C4 diagrams (context/container/component)
  • Custom XML CodeGen Tools – Auto-generating scaffolding

Platforms & Infrastructure

  • Azure Cloud – Core hosting environment
  • Azure SQL Database – Master + tenant-sharded stores
  • Azure CosmosDB – JSON/NoSQL operational store
  • Azure Blob Storage – File storage (documents, exports, results)
  • Azure Service Bus – Messaging, event routing, background jobs
  • Shopify – E-commerce storefront + embedded integration
  • SendGrid – Transactional/notification emails
  • Klaviyo – Marketing automation and campaigns
  • Calendly – Scheduling integration
  • USPS API – Label generation, shipping automation
  • Twilio – SMS messaging and alerts

Observability & Ops

  • Logging/Tracing – Azure Monitor + custom observability layer
  • Metrics – Prometheus-style metrics capture integrated with .NET services
  • Backup/Restore – Azure SQL backups + Mongo dump strategies
  • CI/CD – Git-based pipelines with automated deployments


Required Qualifications

  • 15+ years of professional development experience in complex systems.
  • Deep expertise in ASP.NET Core, .NET 5, and Azure .
  • Strong understanding of multi-tenant architectures, performance optimization, and cost-effective scaling .
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives and mentor other developers.
  • Advanced English (spoken and written): capable of leading meetings, writing documentation, and engaging in negotiations.
  • Proven track record of delivering high-quality, scalable systems.


Soft Skills

  • Trustworthy, respectful, and honest.
  • Hardworking and committed to delivery.
  • High attention to detail.
  • Collaborative, not difficult to work with, and effective in managing differing personalities within the team.


Interview Process

  • 2–3 interview stages , including technical and behavioral assessments.
  • Final decision made by Company’s senior leadership in coordination with the hiring manager.

Desafio: Atuar no desenvolvimento de produtos e sistemas no ramo de saúde animal.


Stack dos projetos:

  • Frontend: React com NextJS, React Native
  • Backend: Nodejs com Express
  • Banco de Dados: MongoDB
  • IA: Ter experiencia com integrações de Serviço de IA por API
  • Bibliotecas Relevantes para se ter conhecimento: date-fns, mongoose, lint, tailwind css, express, google-cli, zod, zustand.


Conhecimentos Essenciais:

  • Ter experiencia com deploy, configuração e manutenção em clusters kubernetes
  • Ter experiencia com configuração de CI e CD para o gitlab utilizando Clusters GKE
  • Ter experiência com uso de WebRTC (Substituto do Jitsi)
  • Ter conhecimento com deploy na loja App Store (iOS)
  • Ter conhecimento com deploy na loja Play Store (Android)
  • Ter conhecimento da arquitetura multi tenant
  • Ter conhecimento de arquitetura de micro serviços Com Service Mesh no GKE
  • Conhecimento das boas práticas de devops utilizando GKE (Service Accounts, IAM e as APIs do Google)
  • Ter conhecimento de XCode no iOS
  • Ter conhecimento com Android Studio



Remuneração máxima: 10k + VA/VR 850 + reembolso de plano de saúde + auxílio creche

title: Gaming Content Moderator
description:
Job Responsibilities:

Review in-game content including text, images, audio, and video to identify and flag inappropriate material such as:

  • Sexual content
  • Violent content
  • Cyberbullying or harassment


Candidate Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in Turkish/ Russian/ Brazilian Portuguese or related field, with relevant language certification
  • Strong language foundation and fluent translation skills; prior translation experience required. Bilingual proficiency is a plus
  • Experience in corpus annotation, content moderation for online communities, or community operations preferred
  • Proficient in computer operations
  • Familiarity with FPS games or MOBA games is a strong advantage
  • Resilient and able to work under pressure
  • Good communication skills, proactive attitude, and strong sense of responsibility

title: Analista de Negócios Digitais
description:
Estamos contratando um(a) Analista de Produtos Digitais para atuar diretamente em um de nossos clientes. Você será a ponte estratégica entre negócio e tecnologia, ajudando a descobrir, desenhar e evoluir soluções digitais de ponta a ponta. Você irá mapear processos, levantar requisitos, prototipar MVPs e orquestrar integrações, acelerando a entrega de valor através de uma abordagem baseada em dados e hipóteses validadas.


Responsabilidades:

  • Discovery e estratégia: conduzir entrevistas, mapear “as-is/to-be”, identificar dores e oportunidades, definir escopo, resultados desejados e critérios de sucesso;
  • Especificação de produto: traduzir necessidades em histórias, fluxos e critérios de aceite, garantindo alinhamento com engenharia e demais stakeholders;
  • Prototipação rápida (hands-on): criar PoCs/MVPs com Lovable e validar com usuários-chave;
  • Automação e integrações: orquestrar fluxos e APIs com n8n (workflows visuais, agentes/LLMs, transformações de dados) e registrar decisões;
  • Validação contínua: estruturar experimentos (smoke tests/MVP), instrumentar medições e consolidar aprendizados para os próximos incrementos ou rodadas de desenvolvimento.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência como Analista de Negócios/Produto em iniciativas digitais (B2B/B2C), com forte capacidade analítica e de facilitação;
  • Mão na massa em prototipação: vivência com Lovable (ou plataforma similar) para criar protótipos funcionais;
  • Automação/orquestração: experiência com n8n (ou equivalente) integrando serviços e montando workflows com APIs;
  • Noções sólidas de APIs REST (design, versionamento, segurança) e documentação clara;
  • Prática com discovery contínuo, testes de hipóteses e rastreabilidade de decisões.


Diferenciais que somam (não eliminatórios):

  • Cases de MVPs lançados rapidamente (Lovable + integrações) e migração de processos legados para arquitetura orientada a APIs.
  • Vivência com governança e riscos em transformação digital.


Informações adicionais:

  • Formato: PJ
  • Local: Remoto (base em São Paulo/SP)
  • Senioridade: Junio a Pleno
  • Início: a combinar

title: Staff Frontend Engineer
description:
Who We Are

Cint is a pioneer in research technology (ResTech). Our customers use the Cint platform to post questions and get answers from real people to build business strategies, confidently publish research, accurately measure the impact of digital advertising, and more. The Cint platform is built on a programmatic marketplace, which is the world’s largest, with nearly 300 million respondents in over 150 countries who consent to sharing their opinions, motivations, and behaviours.

We are feeding the world’s curiosity!

Job Description

The Opportunity

Cint is looking to raise the bar on engineering standards as well as user experiences. We offer a smaller company atmosphere, where engineers can shape technical strategy, lead cross-team initiatives, and set the direction for how we build and deliver products at scale. Our products are redefining experiences within the industry—join us to help define the future of our platform while multiplying the impact of the teams around you.


We’re seeking a Staff Frontend Engineer to join our UI Engineering team. This team is focused on providing frontend solutions to multiple projects and tooling to the whole company. We are deeply committed to advancing our frontend architecture (Next.js), ensuring alignment with our Design Systems, and collaborating with backend teams to deliver consistent, reliable, and user-friendly experiences across the platform.

What You Will Do

As a Staff Frontend Engineer, you will join our globally distributed team to shape and elevate Cint’s Measurement, Survey Platform, and Design System experiences. Your mission is to craft high-quality, scalable user interfaces that power our core research products delivering intuitive experiences for our customers while also enabling internal teams to move faster with confidence.

You will be a product-oriented and platform UI engineer, taking full ownership of the end-to-user experience. This includes partnering closely with UX designers, product managers, and fellow engineers to understand customer and stakeholder needs for both external user-facing products and internal products like our survey platform and design systems.

Responsabilities:

  • Partner closely with Product Managers and UX designers to deliver polished, user-centric experiences and support product rollouts.

  • Create scalable and maintainable frontend components, while enhancing and extending our shared Design System.

  • Monitor and optimize application performance, resolving bottlenecks proactively.

  • Lead cross-team technical initiatives, set architectural direction, and ensure alignment on frontend strategy across the organization.

  • Proactively shape engineering practices, propose improvements, and influence standards adopted by multiple teams.

  • Advocate for and document best practices in frontend development.

  • Own and architect systems or product areas end-to-end, designing solutions that scale across multiple teams and business domains.

  • Build strong cross-functional relationships to ensure smooth collaboration and alignment.

  • Write clean, modular, and maintainable code that stands the test of time.

  • Continuously improve and refactor existing codebases for reliability and efficiency.

  • Take responsibility for production systems through on-call rotations, ensuring stability and fast incident resolution.

  • Mentor and sponsor engineers at all levels, building future technical leaders and spreading best practices throughout the company.

  • Anticipate organizational and architectural challenges, define long-term strategies, and drive adoption of solutions that improve scalability, reliability, and developer experience across Cint.

Qualifications

What We Are Looking For

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time driving cross-team technical initiatives and architectural decisions.

  • Highly proficient in Next.js 14+ (App Router), including expertise in data caching strategies and performance optimization.

  • Demonstrates proficiency in various UI rendering architectures (SSR, CSR, SSG, ISR) and the ability to determine their appropriate application.

  • A proven expertise in designing and implementing robust UI solutions using TypeScript, with a strong focus on applying comprehensive typing throughout the stack to deliver maintainable and highly reliable user experiences.

  • Proficiency in breaking down product documents and abstracts into well-defined feature epics and user stories, driving features from concept to reality promptly.

  • Experience with CSS and Tailwind, and in working with Figma and internal design systems.

  • Track record of building reliable, performant systems and establishing testing and quality practices adopted across teams.

  • Demonstrates strong communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Proven ability to define and drive technical standards across multiple teams or product lines, aligning stakeholders and ensuring adoption.

  • Experience balancing trade-offs between technical debt, speed, and long-term scalability in a way that advances organizational goals.

Additional Information

Our Values

Collaboration is our superpower

  • We uncover rich perspectives across the world
  • Success happens together
  • We deliver across borders.

Innovation is in our blood

  • We’re pioneers in our industry
  • Our curiosity is insatiable
  • We bring the best ideas to life.

We do what we say

  • We’re accountable for our work and actions
  • Excellence comes as standard
  • We’re open, honest and kind, always.

We are caring

  • We learn from each other’s experiences
  • Stop and listen; every opinion matters
  • We embrace diversity, equity and inclusion.


More About Cint

We’re proud to be recognised in Newsweek’s 2025 Global Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces®, reflecting our commitment to a culture of trust, respect, and employee growth.

In June 2021, Cint acquired Berlin-based GapFish – the world’s largest ISO certified online panel community in the DACH region – and in January 2022, completed the acquisition of US-based Lucid – a programmatic research technology platform that provides access to first-party survey data in over 110 countries.

Cint Group AB (publ), listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, this growth has made Cint a strong global platform with teams across its many global offices, including Stockholm, London, New York, New Orleans, Singapore, Tokyo and Sydney. (


Additionally, in a world of AI, we want our candidates to understand our approach to the use of AI during the interview and hiring process, so we'd appreciate you reading our AI usage guide.

description:
Who We Are

Cint is a pioneer in research technology (ResTech). Our customers use the Cint platform to post questions and get answers from real people to build business strategies, confidently publish research, accurately measure the impact of digital advertising, and more. The Cint platform is built on a programmatic marketplace, which is the world’s largest, with nearly 300 million respondents in over 150 countries who consent to sharing their opinions, motivations, and behaviours.

We are feeding the world’s curiosity!

Job Description

The Opportunity

Cint is looking to raise the bar on engineering standards as well as user experiences. We offer a smaller company atmosphere, where engineers can shape technical strategy, lead cross-team initiatives, and set the direction for how we build and deliver products at scale. Our products are redefining experiences within the industry—join us to help define the future of our platform while multiplying the impact of the teams around you.


We’re seeking a Staff Frontend Engineer to join our UI Engineering team. This team is focused on providing frontend solutions to multiple projects and tooling to the whole company. We are deeply committed to advancing our frontend architecture (Next.js), ensuring alignment with our Design Systems, and collaborating with backend teams to deliver consistent, reliable, and user-friendly experiences across the platform.

What You Will Do

As a Staff Frontend Engineer, you will join our globally distributed team to shape and elevate Cint’s Measurement, Survey Platform, and Design System experiences. Your mission is to craft high-quality, scalable user interfaces that power our core research products delivering intuitive experiences for our customers while also enabling internal teams to move faster with confidence.

You will be a product-oriented and platform UI engineer, taking full ownership of the end-to-user experience. This includes partnering closely with UX designers, product managers, and fellow engineers to understand customer and stakeholder needs for both external user-facing products and internal products like our survey platform and design systems.

Responsabilities:

  • Partner closely with Product Managers and UX designers to deliver polished, user-centric experiences and support product rollouts.

  • Create scalable and maintainable frontend components, while enhancing and extending our shared Design System.

  • Monitor and optimize application performance, resolving bottlenecks proactively.

  • Lead cross-team technical initiatives, set architectural direction, and ensure alignment on frontend strategy across the organization.

  • Proactively shape engineering practices, propose improvements, and influence standards adopted by multiple teams.

  • Advocate for and document best practices in frontend development.

  • Own and architect systems or product areas end-to-end, designing solutions that scale across multiple teams and business domains.

  • Build strong cross-functional relationships to ensure smooth collaboration and alignment.

  • Write clean, modular, and maintainable code that stands the test of time.

  • Continuously improve and refactor existing codebases for reliability and efficiency.

  • Take responsibility for production systems through on-call rotations, ensuring stability and fast incident resolution.

  • Mentor and sponsor engineers at all levels, building future technical leaders and spreading best practices throughout the company.

  • Anticipate organizational and architectural challenges, define long-term strategies, and drive adoption of solutions that improve scalability, reliability, and developer experience across Cint.

Qualifications

What We Are Looking For

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time driving cross-team technical initiatives and architectural decisions.

  • Highly proficient in Next.js 14+ (App Router), including expertise in data caching strategies and performance optimization.

  • Demonstrates proficiency in various UI rendering architectures (SSR, CSR, SSG, ISR) and the ability to determine their appropriate application.

  • A proven expertise in designing and implementing robust UI solutions using TypeScript, with a strong focus on applying comprehensive typing throughout the stack to deliver maintainable and highly reliable user experiences.

  • Proficiency in breaking down product documents and abstracts into well-defined feature epics and user stories, driving features from concept to reality promptly.

  • Experience with CSS and Tailwind, and in working with Figma and internal design systems.

  • Track record of building reliable, performant systems and establishing testing and quality practices adopted across teams.

  • Demonstrates strong communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Proven ability to define and drive technical standards across multiple teams or product lines, aligning stakeholders and ensuring adoption.

  • Experience balancing trade-offs between technical debt, speed, and long-term scalability in a way that advances organizational goals.
